{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u096/system/state/workspace/programs/task-0bb7ab47.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Recolor the zero cells inside each rectangular 2-frame that has a
    # single centered 2 marker. The fill color varies with frame size.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 2 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r,c)]
            seen.add((r,c))
            cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and grid[ny][nx]==2 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            top=min(y for y,x in cells); bottom=max(y for y,x in cells)
            left=min(x for y,x in cells); right=max(x for y,x in cells)
            if top==0 or left==0 or bottom==h-1 or right==w-1: # still permit frames at boundaries
                pass
            if bottom-top<2 or right-left<2:
                continue
            if not (all(grid[top][x]==2 and grid[bottom][x]==2 for x in range(left,right+1)) and
                    all(grid[y][left]==2 and grid[y][right]==2 for y in range(top,bottom+1))):
                continue
            interior=[(y,x) for y in range(top+1,bottom) for x in range(left+1,right)]
            marks=[(y,x) for y,x in interior if grid[y][x]==2]
            if len(marks)!=1 or marks[0]!=((top+bottom)//2,(left+right)//2):
                continue
            size=bottom-top+1
            color={5:8,7:4}.get(size, 8)
            for y,x in interior:
                if grid[y][x]==0:
                    out[y][x]=color
    return out
"
}
